chunks.subject: AP Physics 2
chunks.title: Q3 Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB) — 10 points
chunks.content: AP Physics 2 FRQ 3 is Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB), 10 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The LAB task requires designing a procedure (measurements, equipment, controls), planning a linearizing analysis, and reasoning from data/graphs to a conclusion. Q3 topic: an electric-circuit experiment with a capacitor and resistors (e.g., RC charging/discharging or resistance measurement). Points reward: a valid, replicable procedure with correct electrical measurements; a correct graphing/linearization plan; correct slope/intercept interpretation; and data-supported conclusions. Common failure: a procedure missing a needed measurement (e.g., time or voltage); plotting quantities that do not linearize the relationship; conclusions unsupported by the data.

chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 10/10 — complete procedure, correct linearizing graph plan, correct slope/intercept interpretation, and data-supported conclusions. Full-credit model.

chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 8/10 — earned most sub-points, losing a couple where the linearization or the data-based reasoning was incomplete. Illustrates a strong experimental design with a minor analysis gap.

chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 5/10 — earned about half, typically the procedure and some data handling but not the correct linearization or fully data-supported reasoning. Illustrates a partially complete lab design.
